🐟 SPIN AND COLLECT THE RAREST FISH! 🐟

💸 Your Fish Keep Earning Pearls Even While You're Offline! 💸

🎲 How to Play:
🎣 Spin to discover rare and legendary fish!
🫧 Place your fish to automatically earn Pearls.
🦪 Open Clams to unlock even more valuable fish.
⬆️ Buy upgrades to boost your luck and income.
✨ Rebirth for multipliers and unlock new progression!

🤩 Collect hundreds of unique fish, from Common all the way to Cosmic!

🔥 Every spin could be your luckiest one...
💎 Build the rarest collection.
🏆 Flex your best fish to everyone in the server!

⭐ Like the game for future updates!
❤️ Favorite & Follow so you never miss new fish, worlds, and events!
